models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
models.why: Kapitsa, a model-specific Apple Silicon engine, moves 4-bit Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to 154 tok/s on a 48GB M4 Pro (llama.cpp + MTP: 69) and 281 tok/s on an M5 Max; LattePanda's Sigma 2 SBC runs it at ~30 tok/s through OpenVINO.

engines.hardware: MacBook Pro M4 Pro, 48GB unified memory
engines.quant: 4-bit Qwen3.6-35B-A3B + DFlash2; same reported benchmark: oMLX + DFlash2 127, Ollama + MTP 89, LM Studio 86, MTPLX 80, llama.cpp + MTP 69 tok/s
developer-reported Qwen3.6-35B run (no quant stated for this figure); same report: Nemotron 3.5 Super-VL 120B at 85 tok/s

models.name: LFM2.5-24B-A2B
models.why: Liquid AI's on-device agent model: 184 tok/s decode on an M5 Max and 114 on a Ryzen AI Max+ 395, with the Q4 GGUF at ~14.5GB and agent-benchmark leads over Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.

engines.quant: Liquid AI's published figure; 24B total / 2B active MoE, 131K context (up from 32K), trained inside OpenClaw/Hermes Agent/Pi/OpenCode harnesses
32 concurrent requests, output tokens/sec aggregate; an L40S was the best value at 1,110 tok/s per dollar (Massed Compute public GPU benchmark)
